title: Footnote to the Workplace Cafe Management Program Charge Schedule — Drawable Subsidy Funding Refunded
content:
The drawable subsidy funding refunded on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is reckoned from the subsidy funding lots standing on the contract in the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out and from the subsidy drawn over those same twelve months:

- Where two or more subsidy funding lots stand on the contract in the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out and the subsidy drawn over those twelve months falls short of the lots funded over them, the drawable subsidy funding refunded is the lots funded over those twelve months less the subsidy drawn over them, rounded to the nearest cent.
- Where fewer than two subsidy funding lots stand over those twelve months and the subsidy drawn over them falls short of the lots funded over them, the drawable subsidy funding refunded is the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract taken at the unused rollover percentage printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent.
- Where the subsidy drawn over those twelve months reaches the lots funded over them, the drawable subsidy funding refunded is the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract.

| Lots standing over the 12 months up to the day the settlement is worked out | Subsidy drawn over those 12 months | Drawable subsidy funding refunded |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | falls short of the lots funded over them | the lots funded over those twelve months less the subsidy drawn over them, rounded to the nearest cent |
| fewer than 2 | falls short of the lots funded over them | the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract taken at the unused rollover percentage printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent |
| any number | reaches the lots funded over them | the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract |

The count of lots and the two amounts are all read over one and the same window, the twelve months up to the day the settlement is worked out. Subsidy drawn that reaches the lots funded over that window leaves nothing short, and in that case the subsidy funding balance standing on the contract is taken as it stands.

On hypothetical records showing 3 subsidy funding lots standing over those twelve months, lots funded of 31500.00 USD and subsidy drawn of 24750.00 USD, the drawable subsidy funding refunded is 6750.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent. The figures are hypothetical and are shown only to work the first line through.
